caseNameFull: Camden Trust Co. v. Gidney, Comptroller of the Currency
attorneys: Bernard G. Segal and Samuel D. Slade for petitioner., Solicitor General Cox, Assistant Attorney General Orrick and John G. Laughlin, Jr. for the Comptroller of the Currency, and Arthur Littleton for Delaware Valley National Bank of Delaware Township, respondents., Briefs of amici curiae, in support of the petition, were filed by Arthur J. Sills, Attorney General of New Jersey, and David Landau, Deputy Attorney General, for the State of New Jersey, and by James F. Bell for the National Association of Supervisors of State Banks.

opinions.text: United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit. Certiorari denied.
